decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the core pipeline-fittings business, was promoted to its own page in 2019, and costs little to keep in the range, so it stays as a low-cost option that complements established products.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core but uses the existing coating and fabrication capacity, and its value to municipal customers is still uncertain, so keeping this cheap option is still justified.

The waste bin with ashtray is a low-cost variant of the bin line made on existing equipment, so it stays while demand from municipal buyers remains unresolved, though it is a likely candidate for consolidation.

The standalone outdoor ashtray is the most peripheral item in a distant product line and overlaps with the combined bin, so the option has likely resolved poorly and its resources are better spent on the core infrastructure business.
